newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair says to expand Delta co-op.
newsitem.headline: Finnair says to expand Delta co-op.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would expand its cooperation with U.S. Delta Air Lines Inc by introducing a new code share flight between Helsinki and San Francisco.
"Delta will reserve seats on Finnair's San Francisco flights and sell them on its own route number," Finnair said.
The flights to San Francisco would begin on May 15 and the route would be flown three times a week up to September 6, it said.
Finnair and Delta began code sharing in October 1995 and cooperation between the airlines extends to frequent flier points which can be used on both carriers.
